fusions.name: Summit Rush
fusions.desc: Rushes you up to 6 tiles onto the target and deals 18 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Low Sweep
fusions.desc: Charges low and sweeps, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Each use costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Unmoved
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Bedrock Habit
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 12%, and your other abilities come round 6% sooner.
